en.perf_n_abandoned: {n} gave up before a teller answered
en.perf_desk_note: Open counts are right now and are never hidden by the window; filed and resolved count the window.
en.perf_busy_note: Customer messages by hour of day, in your local time.
en.perf_no_messages: No customer messages in this window yet.
en.global_search_aria: Search conversations, escalations, knowledge base and curated answers
en.customers_can_reach_teller: Customers can reach a teller now
en.customers_reach_colleague: Customers can reach a colleague — you are off duty
en.oldest_first: Oldest first. The longest wait is the one to take.
en.account_question_answered: Answered a question only the account holder could
en.queue_empty: Nothing is waiting in the queue.
en.unclassified_note: {n} earlier replies carry no outcome and are not counted above.
en.nothing_asked_yet: Nothing asked yet in this window.
en.grouped_by_wording: Grouped by wording. Phone numbers and names are removed before grouping.
en.what_happened_when_asked: What happened when this was asked
en.no_conversations_window: No conversations yet in this window.
en.preview_caption: Exactly what a customer sees on your website. Messages sent here are real and appear in Conversations.
en.branding_help: Your colour and logo, used in this panel and in the chat widget on your website. Saved values apply immediately — no deploy.
en.brand_name_help: What people call you — for example "CBE". Shown in the chat header, this panel and greetings to customers. Leave blank to use your registered name, {legal}, which is kept either way for printed reports.
en.seeded_colours_help: Seeded colours are our reading of your public site, not your brand book. If it is wrong, this is where to fix it.
en.webhook_help: Where escalations are delivered in your contact-centre tool. Requests are signed, so the receiving system can verify they came from us. Clear the field to disconnect.
en.signing_secret_set: A signing secret is set. It cannot be shown again — saving a URL here issues a new one and the old one stops working.
en.password_change_help: Changing it signs out every other browser you are signed in on.
en.password_changed: Password changed. Other sessions were signed out.
en.no_calls_taken_yet: Nobody has taken a call yet in this window.
en.no_calls_yet_window: No calls yet in this window.
en.temp_password_help: At least 12 characters. Until invitation emails are set up, this password has to be given to them directly — which is why it is shown here rather than hidden.
en.confirm_disable_account: Disable this account? They will be signed out immediately.
en.show_hide_channels: Show or hide the channel list
en.call_started: The customer asked for a person here
en.switched_on_nobody_on_duty: Switched on — but nobody is on duty
en.no_teller_button: No “Speak to a teller” button appears in your widget.
en.on_duty_explainer: You are on duty, so waiting customers can be routed to you. Go off duty from the sidebar when you step away — you stay on the air anywhere in the console until you do.
en.off_duty_explainer: Switch On duty in the sidebar to start taking calls. It follows you across every page, so you no longer have to keep this one open.
en.colleague_must_be_on_duty: A colleague with permission to take calls has to be on duty before customers are offered one.
en.i_can_converse_in: I can hold a conversation in:
en.languages_picked_note: Customers writing in these reach you first. Everyone else still reaches you — after a short wait, so nobody is stranded.
en.languages_none_note: Nothing selected, so every waiting customer is offered to you in plain oldest-first order.
en.languages_first_note: Your languages first, longest wait within each. Anyone waiting too long moves to the top whatever they speak.
en.desks_picked_note: Questions about these desks reach you first. Everything else still reaches you — after a short wait, so nobody is stranded.
en.desks_none_note: Nothing selected, so desk topics do not change your queue order.
en.desks_first_note: Your desks first, longest wait within each. Anyone waiting too long moves to the top whatever they ask about.
en.routing_first_note: Your languages first, your desks within them, longest wait within each. Anyone waiting too long moves to the top.
en.session_scope_body: Before someone is identified: general questions about products, eligibility and how to apply. Once you have checked their Fayda ID against the account and asked something only the account holder could answer: their own application, documents and disputes.
en.never_money_movement: Never, at any point and for anyone: deposits, withdrawals or transfers. Those do not happen on a call.
en.live_waiting_one: {n} customer waiting for a live call
en.live_waiting_many: {n} customers waiting for a live call
en.customer_left_call: The customer has left the call.
en.mic_blocked: Microphone access is blocked. Allow it in your browser and take the session again.
en.verified_scope: You can now discuss their own records, take documents and file a dispute. Never a deposit, withdrawal or transfer.
en.establish_who_they_are: Establish who they are — either one
en.chk_id_document: Fayda ID shown and matches the account name
en.chk_fayda_matched: Fayda number matches the account record
en.chk_fayda_matched_note: on your own screen — works on an audio call
en.chk_id_photo: Photo on the ID matches the person on the call
en.confirm_account_theirs: And confirm the account is theirs
en.unverified_scope: Until this is done you can only give general guidance — products, eligibility and how to apply.
en.fayda_number_required: Fayda number (required — it is what the record keeps)
en.nothing_to_download: No approved answers to download yet.

am.perf_desk_note: ክፍት ቁጥሮች የአሁን ናቸው እና በጊዜ መስኮቱ አይደበቁም፤ የገቡ እና የተፈቱ በመስኮቱ ውስጥ ይቆጠራሉ።
am.perf_busy_note: የደንበኞች መልዕክቶች በቀን ሰዓት፣ በአካባቢዎ ሰዓት።
am.perf_no_messages: በዚህ ጊዜ ውስጥ የደንበኛ መልዕክት እስካሁን የለም።
am.global_search_aria: ውይይቶችን፣ የተላለፉ ጥያቄዎችን፣ የመረጃ ማዕከልን እና የጸደቁ መልሶችን ይፈልጉ
am.customers_can_reach_teller: ደንበኞች አሁን ገንዘብ ያዥ ማግኘት ይችላሉ
am.customers_reach_colleague: ደንበኞች ባልደረባዎን ያገኛሉ — እርስዎ ከሥራ ውጪ ነዎት
am.oldest_first: የቆየው መጀመሪያ። ረጅም የጠበቀው መጀመሪያ ይወሰዳል።
am.account_question_answered: የሂሳቡ ባለቤት ብቻ የሚያውቀውን ጥያቄ መልሷል
am.no_days_yet: በዚህ ጊዜ ውስጥ እስካሁን ምንም የለም።
am.unclassified_note: {n} ቀደም ያሉ መልሶች ውጤት የላቸውም፤ ከላይ አልተቆጠሩም።
am.grouped_by_wording: በአገላለጽ የተመደበ። ስልክ ቁጥሮችና ስሞች ከመመደቡ በፊት ይወገዳሉ።
am.preview_caption: ደንበኛ በድረ-ገጽዎ ላይ የሚያየው በትክክል ይህ ነው። እዚህ የሚላኩ መልእክቶች እውነተኛ ናቸው እና በውይይቶች ውስጥ ይታያሉ።
am.branding_help: በዚህ ፓነልና በድረ-ገጽዎ ላይ ባለው የውይይት መስኮት የሚያገለግሉ ቀለምዎና አርማዎ። የተቀመጡ እሴቶች ወዲያውኑ ተግባራዊ ይሆናሉ — ማሰማራት አያስፈልግም።
am.brand_name_help: ሰዎች የሚጠሩዎት ስም — ለምሳሌ "CBE"። በውይይቱ ራስጌ፣ በዚህ ፓነልና ለደንበኞች በሚቀርብ ሰላምታ ላይ ይታያል። ባዶ ከተውት የተመዘገበው ስምዎ {legal} ይሆናል፤ ለሚታተሙ ሪፖርቶች በሁለቱም መንገድ ይቀመጣል።
am.seeded_colours_help: የቀረቡት ቀለሞች ከይፋዊ ድረ-ገጽዎ የተወሰዱ ግምቶች እንጂ ከምርት መመሪያ መጽሐፍዎ አይደሉም። ስህተት ከሆነ የሚታረመው እዚህ ነው።
am.webhook_help: ጉዳዮች በእርስዎ የደንበኞች መገልገያ መሣሪያ ውስጥ የሚደርሱበት ቦታ። ጥያቄዎቹ የተፈረሙ ናቸው፤ ስለዚህ ተቀባዩ ሥርዓት ከእኛ መምጣታቸውን ማረጋገጥ ይችላል። ለማቋረጥ መስኩን ባዶ ያድርጉ።
am.signing_secret_set: የፊርማ ሚስጥር ተዘጋጅቷል። እንደገና ማሳየት አይቻልም — እዚህ አድራሻ ማስቀመጥ አዲስ ያወጣል፤ አሮጌው መስራት ያቆማል።
am.password_change_help: መቀየር በገቡበት በሌላ በእያንዳንዱ አሳሽ ላይ ያስወጣዎታል።
am.password_changed: የይለፍ ቃል ተቀይሯል። ሌሎች ክፍለ-ጊዜዎች ወጥተዋል።
am.no_calls_taken_yet: በዚህ ጊዜ ውስጥ ማንም ጥሪ አልያዘም።
am.temp_password_help: ቢያንስ 12 ቁምፊ። የግብዣ ኢሜይሎች እስኪዘጋጁ ድረስ ይህ የይለፍ ቃል በቀጥታ ሊሰጣቸው ይገባል — ስለዚህ ተደብቆ ሳይሆን እዚህ ይታያል።
am.switched_on_nobody_on_duty: በርቷል — ግን ማንም በሥራ ላይ የለም
am.no_teller_button: በመግብርዎ ውስጥ “ከገንዘብ ተቀባይ ጋር ይነጋገሩ” የሚል አዝራር አይታይም።
am.on_duty_explainer: በሥራ ላይ ነዎት፤ ስለዚህ የሚጠብቁ ደንበኞች ወደ እርስዎ ሊመሩ ይችላሉ። ሲርቁ ከጎን አሞሌው ከሥራ ውጡ — እስከዚያ ድረስ በየትኛውም ገጽ ላይ በሥራ ላይ ይቆያሉ።
am.off_duty_explainer: ጥሪዎችን መቀበል ለመጀመር ከጎን አሞሌው “በሥራ ላይ” ያብሩ። በሁሉም ገጽ ላይ ይከተልዎታል፤ ስለዚህ ይህን ገጽ ክፍት ማድረግ አያስፈልግም።
am.colleague_must_be_on_duty: ጥሪ የመቀበል ፈቃድ ያለው ባልደረባ በሥራ ላይ መሆን አለበት፤ ከዚያ በፊት ለደንበኞች አይቀርብም።
am.languages_picked_note: በእነዚህ ቋንቋዎች የሚጽፉ ደንበኞች መጀመሪያ ወደ እርስዎ ይደርሳሉ። ሌሎችም ይደርሳሉ — ከአጭር ጥበቃ በኋላ፤ ማንም አይቀርም።
am.languages_none_note: ምንም አልተመረጠም፤ ስለዚህ እያንዳንዱ የሚጠብቅ ደንበኛ በቀላል ቀዳሚ-መጀመሪያ ቅደም ተከተል ይቀርብልዎታል።
am.languages_first_note: የእርስዎ ቋንቋዎች መጀመሪያ፤ በእያንዳንዱ ውስጥ ረጅም የጠበቀው ይቀድማል። ከልክ በላይ የጠበቀ ማንኛውም ሰው የሚናገረው ምንም ይሁን ወደ ላይ ይወጣል።
am.desks_picked_note: ስለ እነዚህ ዴስኮች የሚነሱ ጥያቄዎች መጀመሪያ ወደ እርስዎ ይደርሳሉ። ሌላው ሁሉ አሁንም ይደርሳል — ከአጭር ጥበቃ በኋላ፤ ማንም አይቀርም።
am.desks_none_note: ምንም አልተመረጠም፤ ስለዚህ የዴስክ ርዕሶች የወረፋዎን ቅደም ተከተል አይለውጡም።
am.desks_first_note: የእርስዎ ዴስኮች መጀመሪያ፤ በእያንዳንዱ ውስጥ ረጅም የጠበቀው ይቀድማል። ከልክ በላይ የጠበቀ ማንኛውም ሰው ስለ ምንም ይጠይቅ ወደ ላይ ይወጣል።
am.routing_first_note: የእርስዎ ቋንቋዎች መጀመሪያ፣ በውስጣቸው የእርስዎ ዴስኮች፣ በእያንዳንዱ ውስጥ ረጅም የጠበቀው ይቀድማል። ከልክ በላይ የጠበቀ ወደ ላይ ይወጣል።
am.session_scope_body: አንድ ሰው ከመለየቱ በፊት፦ ስለ ምርቶች፣ ብቁነትና እንዴት ማመልከት እንደሚቻል አጠቃላይ ጥያቄዎች። የፋይዳ መታወቂያቸውን ከሂሳቡ ጋር አመሳክረው የሂሳቡ ባለቤት ብቻ ሊመልሰው የሚችለውን ከጠየቁ በኋላ፦ የራሳቸው ማመልከቻ፣ ሰነዶችና ቅሬታዎች።
am.never_money_movement: በፍጹም፣ በማንኛውም ጊዜና ለማንም፦ ተቀማጭ፣ ወጪ ወይም ማስተላለፍ የለም። እነዚያ በጥሪ ላይ አይፈጸሙም።

ti.colleague_must_be_on_duty: ጻውዒት ናይ ምቕባል ፍቓድ ዘለዎ መሳርሕቲ ኣብ ስራሕ ክህሉ ኣለዎ፣ ቅድሚኡ ንዓማዊል ኣይቀርብን።
ti.languages_picked_note: በዞም ቋንቋታት ዝጽሕፉ ዓማዊል ቅድም ናባኹም ይበጽሑ። እቶም ካልኦት እውን ይበጽሑ — ድሕሪ ሓጺር ጽበት፣ ዋላ ሓደ ኣይተርፍን።
ti.languages_none_note: ዋላ ሓደ ኣይተመርጸን፣ ስለዚ ነፍስ ወከፍ ዝጽበ ዓሚል ብቐሊል ናይ ቀዳምነት ስርዓት ይቐርበልኩም።
ti.languages_first_note: ቋንቋታትኩም ቅድም፣ ኣብ ነፍስ ወከፍ እቲ ነዊሕ ዝጸንሐ ይቐድም። ካብ ንቡር ንላዕሊ ዝጸንሐ ዝኾነ ሰብ ዝዛረቦ ብዘየገድስ ናብ ላዕሊ ይመጽእ።
ti.desks_picked_note: ብዛዕባ እዞም ዴስክታት ዝለዓሉ ሕቶታት ቅድም ናባኹም ይበጽሑ። ካልእ ኩሉ እውን ይበጽሕ — ድሕሪ ሓጺር ጽበት፣ ዋላ ሓደ ኣይተርፍን።
ti.desks_none_note: ዋላ ሓደ ኣይተመርጸን፣ ስለዚ ኣርእስታት ዴስክ ስርዓት ሰልፍኹም ኣይልውጡን።
ti.desks_first_note: ዴስክታትኩም ቅድም፣ ኣብ ነፍስ ወከፍ እቲ ነዊሕ ዝጸንሐ ይቐድም። ካብ ንቡር ንላዕሊ ዝጸንሐ ዝኾነ ሰብ ብዛዕባ እንታይ ይሓትት ብዘየገድስ ናብ ላዕሊ ይመጽእ።
ti.routing_first_note: ቋንቋታትኩም ቅድም፣ ኣብ ውሽጦም ዴስክታትኩም፣ ኣብ ነፍስ ወከፍ እቲ ነዊሕ ዝጸንሐ ይቐድም። ካብ ንቡር ንላዕሊ ዝጸንሐ ናብ ላዕሊ ይመጽእ።
ti.session_scope_body: ሓደ ሰብ ቅድሚ ምልላዩ፦ ብዛዕባ ኣቕሑ፣ ብቕዓትን ከመይ ጌርካ ከም እትሓትትን ሓፈሻዊ ሕቶታት። መንነት ፋይዳኦም ምስ ሕሳብ ኣረጋጊጽኩም እቲ ወናኒ ሕሳብ ጥራይ ክምልሶ ዝኽእል ምስ ሓተትኩም፦ ናቶም ምልክታ፣ ሰነዳትን ጥርዓናትን።
ti.never_money_movement: ፈጺሙ፣ ኣብ ዝኾነ እዋንን ንዝኾነ ሰብን፦ መቐመጢ፣ ወጻኢ ወይ ምትሕልላፍ የለን። እዚኣቶም ኣብ ጻውዒት ኣይፍጸሙን።
ti.mic_blocked: መእተዊ ማይክሮፎን ተዓጊቱ። ኣብ መርበብ መንሸራተቲኹም ፍቐዱ እሞ ነቲ ክፍለ-ግዜ ደጊምኩም ውሰዱ።
ti.verified_scope: ሕጂ ብዛዕባ ናቶም መዝገባት ክትዘራረቡ፣ ሰነዳት ክትቅበሉን ጥርዓን ከተመዝግቡን ትኽእሉ። ፈጺሙ መቐመጢ፣ ወጻኢ ወይ ምትሕልላፍ የለን።
ti.chk_id_document: መንነት ፋይዳ ተራእዩን ምስ ስም ሕሳብ ይሰማማዕን
ti.chk_fayda_matched: ቁጽሪ ፋይዳ ምስ መዝገብ ሕሳብ ይሰማማዕ
ti.chk_fayda_matched_note: ኣብ ናትኩም መርአዪ — ኣብ ናይ ድምጺ ጻውዒት እውን ይሰርሕ
ti.chk_id_photo: እቲ ኣብ መንነት ዘሎ ስእሊ ምስቲ ኣብ ጻውዒት ዘሎ ሰብ ይሰማማዕ
ti.confirm_account_theirs: ከምኡ'ውን እቲ ሕሳብ ናቶም ምዃኑ ኣረጋግጹ
ti.unverified_scope: እዚ ክሳብ ዝፍጸም ሓፈሻዊ መምርሒ ጥራይ ክትህቡ ትኽእሉ — ኣቕሑ፣ ብቕዓትን ከመይ ጌርካ ከም እትሓትትን።
ti.fayda_number_required: ቁጽሪ ፋይዳ (የድሊ — እቲ መዝገብ ዝሕዞ እዚ እዩ)
ti.nothing_to_download: ክሳብ ሕጂ ዝወርድ ዝጸደቐ መልሲ የለን።

so.branding_help: Midabkaaga iyo astaantaada, oo laga isticmaalo daaqadan iyo widget-ka sheekada degelkaaga. Qiyamka la keydiyay isla markiiba way shaqeeyaan — geyn looma baahna.
so.brand_name_help: Waxa dadku kugu yeeraan — tusaale "CBE". Waxay ka muuqataa madaxa sheekada, daaqadan iyo salaanta macaamiisha. Haddii aad banaan ka tagto waxaa la isticmaalayaa magacaaga diiwaangashan, {legal}, oo si kastaba lagu hayo warbixinnada la daabaco.
so.seeded_colours_help: Midabbada la soo bandhigay waa akhrinteenna degelkaaga guud, ma aha buuggaaga astaanta. Haddii ay khalad tahay, halkan ayaa lagu saxaa.
so.webhook_help: Halka arrimaha lagu gudbiyo qalabkaaga xarunta macaamiisha. Codsiyada waa la saxeexay, sidaas darteed nidaamka qaataa wuu xaqiijin karaa inay naga yimaadeen. Si aad u gooyso, banaani meesha.
so.signing_secret_set: Sir saxeex ayaa la dejiyay. Mar kale lama tusi karo — URL halkan lagu keydiyo wuxuu soo saarayaa mid cusub, kii hore wuu shaqo joojiyaa.
so.password_change_help: Beddelkeedu wuxuu kaa saarayaa dhammaan browser-yada kale ee aad ku jirto.
so.password_changed: Furaha sirta ah waa la beddelay. Kalfadhiyada kale waa laga saaray.

so.temp_password_help: Ugu yaraan 12 xaraf. Ilaa iimaylada casumaadda la dejiyo, furahan si toos ah ayaa loo siin doonaa — sidaas darteed halkan ayuu ka muuqdaa halkii la qarin lahaa.

so.on_duty_explainer: Shaqada ayaad joogtaa, sidaas darteed macaamiisha sugaya waa lagu soo dhiibi karaa. Marka aad tagto shaqada ka bax dhinaca — ilaa markaas bog kasta ayaad ku sii shaqeynaysaa.
so.off_duty_explainer: Si aad u bilowdo qaadista wicitaannada, dhinaca ka shid “Shaqada”. Bog kasta ayuu kula socdaa, sidaas darteed uma baahnid inaad tan furan ka tagto.
so.colleague_must_be_on_duty: Shaqaale haysta ogolaanshaha qaadista wicitaannada waa inuu shaqada joogaa ka hor inta aan macaamiisha la siin.
so.languages_picked_note: Macaamiisha ku qora kuwan ayaa marka hore kugu soo gaara. Qof kastana wuu ku soo gaari doonaa — sug gaaban ka dib, sidaas qofna ma harayo.
so.languages_none_note: Waxba lama dooran, sidaas darteed macmiil kasta oo sugaya waxaa laguu soo bandhigayaa sida caadiga ah ee ugu horreeya.
so.languages_first_note: Luqadahaaga marka hore, kii ugu sugay dheeraa mid kasta gudahood. Qof kasta oo aad u sugay ayaa kor u kaca luqad kastoo uu ku hadloba.
so.desks_picked_note: Su'aalaha ku saabsan miisaskan ayaa marka hore kugu soo gaara. Wax kastoo kalena wuu ku soo gaaraa — sug gaaban ka dib, sidaas qofna ma harayo.
so.desks_none_note: Waxba lama dooran, sidaas darteed mowduucyada miisasku ma beddelaan kala horreynta safkaaga.
so.desks_first_note: Miisaskaaga marka hore, kii ugu sugay dheeraa mid kasta gudahood. Qof kasta oo aad u sugay ayaa kor u kaca wax kastoo uu weydiinayoba.
so.routing_first_note: Luqadahaaga marka hore, miisaskaaga gudahood, kii ugu sugay dheeraa mid kasta gudahood. Qof aad u sugay ayaa kor u kaca.
so.session_scope_body: Ka hor inta aan qofka la aqoonsan: su'aalo guud oo ku saabsan alaabta, u-qalmitaanka iyo sida loo codsado. Marka aad hubiso aqoonsigooda Fayda ee xisaabta oo aad weydiiso wax uu kaliya milkiilaha xisaabtu ka jawaabi karo: codsigooda, dukumiintiyada iyo cabashooyinka.
so.never_money_movement: Weligaa, wakhti kasta iyo qof kasta: dhigasho, qaadis ama wareejin ma jirto. Kuwaas wicitaan laguma sameeyo.

sw.show_hide_channels: Onyesha au ficha orodha ya njia
sw.no_teller_button: Hakuna kitufe cha "Zungumza na Afisa" kinachoonekana kwenye kidirisha chako.
sw.on_duty_explainer: Upo kazini, kwa hivyo wateja wanaosubiri wanaweza kuelekezwa kwako. Toka kazini kutoka upande wa kando unapoondoka — unabaki kwenye mtandao popote kwenye paneli mpaka utakapofanya hivyo.
sw.off_duty_explainer: Washa Kazini kwenye upande wa kando ili kuanza kupokea simu. Inakufuata kwenye kila ukurasa, hivyo huhitaji tena kuweka huu wazi.
sw.colleague_must_be_on_duty: Mwenzako mwenye ruhusa ya kupokea simu lazima awe kazini kabla wateja hawajapewa fursa hiyo.
sw.languages_picked_note: Wateja wanaoandika kwa lugha hizi wanakufikia kwanza. Kila mtu mwingine bado anakufikia — baada ya kusubiri kidogo, ili asibaki bila msaada.
sw.languages_none_note: Hakuna kilichochaguliwa, kwa hivyo kila mteja anayesubiri anapewa kwako kwa mpangilio wa zamani zaidi kwanza.
sw.languages_first_note: Lugha zako kwanza, aliyesubiri kwa muda mrefu zaidi ndani ya kila moja. Yeyote anayesubiri kwa muda mrefu sana anapanda juu bila kujali anazungumza lugha gani.
sw.desks_picked_note: Maswali kuhusu madawati haya yanakufikia kwanza. Mengine yote bado yanakufikia — baada ya kusubiri kidogo, ili asibaki mtu bila msaada.
sw.desks_none_note: Hakuna kilichochaguliwa, kwa hivyo mada za madawati hazibadilishi mpangilio wa foleni yako.
sw.desks_first_note: Madawati yako kwanza, aliyesubiri kwa muda mrefu zaidi ndani ya kila moja. Yeyote anayesubiri kwa muda mrefu sana anapanda juu bila kujali anauliza nini.
sw.routing_first_note: Lugha zako kwanza, madawati yako ndani yake, aliyesubiri kwa muda mrefu zaidi ndani ya kila moja. Anayesubiri kwa muda mrefu sana anapanda juu.
sw.session_scope_body: Kabla mtu hajatambuliwa: maswali ya jumla kuhusu bidhaa, sifa za kustahiki na jinsi ya kuomba. Baada ya kukagua Kitambulisho chao cha Fayda dhidi ya akaunti na kuuliza kitu ambacho mmiliki wa akaunti pekee angeweza kujibu: maombi yao wenyewe, nyaraka na migogoro.
sw.never_money_movement: Kamwe, wakati wowote na kwa yeyote: amana, uondoaji au uhamishaji. Hizo hazifanyiki kwenye simu.
sw.open_live_queue: Fungua foleni ya simu za moja kwa moja
sw.live_waiting_one: Mteja {n} anasubiri simu ya moja kwa moja
sw.live_waiting_many: Wateja {n} wanasubiri simu ya moja kwa moja
sw.switch_dark_light: Badilisha Kati ya Giza na Mwanga
sw.mic_blocked: Ufikiaji wa maikrofoni umezuiwa. Ruhusu kwenye kivinjari chako na uanze kikao tena.
sw.verified_scope: Sasa unaweza kuzungumzia rekodi zao wenyewe, kuchukua nyaraka na kuwasilisha mgogoro. Kamwe amana, uondoaji au uhamishaji.
sw.chk_id_document: Kitambulisho cha Fayda kimeonyeshwa na kinalingana na jina la akaunti
sw.chk_fayda_matched: Namba ya Fayda inalingana na rekodi ya akaunti
sw.chk_fayda_matched_note: kwenye skrini yako mwenyewe — inafanya kazi kwenye simu ya sauti
sw.chk_id_photo: Picha kwenye kitambulisho inalingana na mtu aliye kwenye simu
sw.unverified_scope: Hadi hili litakapofanyika unaweza tu kutoa mwongozo wa jumla — bidhaa, sifa za kustahiki na jinsi ya kuomba.
sw.fayda_number_required: Namba ya Fayda (inahitajika — ndiyo inayowekwa kwenye rekodi)
sw.nothing_to_download: Hakuna majibu yaliyoidhinishwa ya kupakua bado.
